objective: Count how many of the six specified products have at least 2 items available today at the Veveri PowerTool store in Brno.

params.store_identification: lookup store_id from stores where store_name = 'Veveri PowerTool' and city = 'Brno'
params.product_identification: for each of the six products described in the instruction, identify its product_sku by matching brand, series, model, and specific property key-value pairs from product_variants and product_variant_properties
